settings.dropbox.title: Dropbox configuration sync
settings.dropbox.privacyStorage: Only the FluentRead app folder in Dropbox is accessed, not your other files.
settings.dropbox.description: Save your complete configuration encrypted in your own Dropbox and restore it on other devices. Includes API keys, OAuth tokens, authentication headers, custom request bodies and authentication parameters in URLs; excludes your wordbook, chat history and usage statistics.
settings.dropbox.selectedAccount: Sync uses the account you selected in Dropbox.
settings.dropbox.downloadDescription: Replace this device’s settings and credentials with the configuration in Dropbox.
settings.dropbox.uploadDescription: Save this device’s settings and credentials to Dropbox, replacing the existing cloud configuration.
settings.dropbox.error.notConfigured: Dropbox sync is not enabled in this build. The maintainer must configure the app first.
settings.dropbox.error.unsupported: Dropbox sync requires a browser extension with identity and session storage support. Use a complete data backup in this environment.
settings.dropbox.error.permission: Dropbox denied access. Check app permissions and development users.
settings.dropbox.error.rateLimit: Too many Dropbox requests. Try again later.
settings.dropbox.error.authorization: Dropbox authorization did not complete. Start sync again.
settings.dropbox.error.network: Dropbox request failed or returned an invalid response. Check your connection and retry.
settings.dropbox.error.account: Unable to verify the Dropbox account. Authorize again.
settings.dropbox.error.canceled: Dropbox authorization canceled. Device configuration was not changed.
settings.dropbox.error.callback: Invalid Dropbox callback. Check the registered redirect URL.
settings.dropbox.error.scope: Dropbox permissions are incomplete. Check app scopes and authorize again.
settings.dropbox.error.accountChanged: Dropbox account changed. Generate a new preview.
settings.dropbox.error.file: Invalid Dropbox sync file metadata. Check the backup in the app folder.
settings.dropbox.error.size: Sync file exceeds 32 MiB. Reduce custom configuration or use a complete data backup.
settings.dropbox.error.request: Dropbox request did not complete. Generate a new preview later.
settings.dropbox.error.encrypted: Only locally encrypted configuration within the size limit can be uploaded.
settings.dropbox.error.conflict: Cloud configuration changed. Generate a new preview.
settings.dropbox.error.settingsOnly: Dropbox sync is only available from extension settings.
